title.narrative: Jordan Innovative Startups and SMEs Fund 2.0

description.narrative: The objective of the Innovative Startups and SMEs Fund 2.0 for Jordan is to mobilize private capital for early-stage equity financing and job creation by innovative startups and small and medium enterprises, or SMEs. There are three components to the project, the first component being a fund of funds investments, including pre-seed and seed investments to catalyze the pipeline. It is envisioned that the majority of investments under the ISSF 2.0 project will be made through a Fund of Funds component focused on attracting new VC funds to Jordan. The core objective of this component is for ISSF to act as a catalyst for the VC ecosystem in Jordan to attract more regional and global VC funds (across different growth stages) to the country, leading to increased availability of early-stage financing in the short, medium, and longer term. Ongoing implementation experience by ISSF and good practices for Fund of Funds at the global level show this is an efficient way to generate impact and attract fresh private capital. The second component is the co-investment in startups with lead VC and institutional investors. A small share of investable capital will be allocated for co-investments in early-stage startups along with VC Funds. ISSF will invest (through equity acquisition of shares, quasi-equity instruments, and convertible notes, e.g., safe notes) in selected startups following a qualified lead institutional investor, who will have the main role in conducting the due diligence and the terms of the round. Finally, the third component is project management, implementation, and capacity-building support. This component will support project management and implementation activities by the Project Management Unit (PMU).
